# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** 8 (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is characterized by a neat and proper presentation, often seen wearing a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a "prunes and prisms" mouth. Her appearance is completed by long, sleek curls that consistently remain in perfect order.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a remarkably quiet, neat, and faithful child who conducts herself like a model of good behavior. Characterized by her prim and demure manner, she is observant, industrious, and never needs to be told how to do a task twice. She carries out her duties carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, proving to be an exceptionally good and well-behaved child who causes no trouble. Described as placid and composed even in frightening situations, her exceedingly proper and predictable nature can make her seem somewhat monotonous.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), +10 more_

## History

Dora Keith comes to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), following their mother's funeral. Unlike her disruptive brother, Dora behaves quietly, though [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) subjects her to misadventures such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen and locking her in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse. She later requires comforting from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) after being frightened by ghost stories at school. Following the death of her uncle, [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), money left in trust ensures that Dora and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) can stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). As she grows up, Dora continues to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends college, occasionally falling victim to Davy's schemes, such as when he drags her away from Sunday school to go fishing.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), +474 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's brother, who came to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alongside her after their mother's funeral. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) frequently targets the well-behaved Dora with mischievous pranks, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen and locking her inside a neighbor's toolhouse before lying about her whereabouts. Despite his unruly antics and occasional jealousy over Anne's attention to other children, they continue to share daily life and outings together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +9 more</sub>
